notes.title: Closing demo date and graphics update
notes.notes:
Greatings friends!

So, it's been a long time since the Sich Tactics demo was published. We are very grateful to everyone who played, and especially to those who left feedback. It helps us make the game better. This is only a small part of the game and there is still a lot of work to be done. However, we are constantly working on improving it. Since the release of the demo, we've been making small changes to make it more user-friendly.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42597953/47fc22649352917880e8b0885ceefe0627059088.jpg[/img]

In the process of developing the core mechanics of the game, we decided to add a small visual update to the units. We are still working on the overall visual style of the game, so there may be some changes before release to make the game more cohesive.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42597953/96951e7011d9fb6847c6e42bbe91172a34ddb89e.jpg[/img]

We also want to let you know that the demo will be available for one more week ([b]until and including September 22nd[/b]), after which we will close it until all the core game mechanics are ready. This will allow us to gather feedback again and better understand your expectations.

Have time to play and be sure to fill out the feedback form. Help us make the game better!

notes.title: Development Update #3
notes.notes:
Greetings, everyone!

We decided to tell you a little bit about one of our mechanics and share some progress on the interface on the ocassion of Ukrainian Games Festival.

Verticality is a big part of the design of Sich Tactics. Cells have different height, this creates an additional layer to movement planning. However there is not only danger - characters receive damage after falling from high - but also an opportunity.

Some characters have the ability to jump over chasms, others do not receive fall damage while moving. More than that, cossacks can push their fellows onto the high ground to take the most advantageous positions

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42597953/0b4843f427c16146a83503b3916b1363d11dc6db.gif[/img]

Also we are working on the player's interface. We really want to convey the atmosphere of the game world, at the same time make a convenient and friendly interface that will help the player quickly understand what is happening and display all the necessary game information for the best experience and interaction on the battlefield.

Current result you can see on the screenshot, but it’s still work in progress.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42597953/50ee0009651e16bac23717f73d757c16e71df9c0.jpg[/img]

We are pushing forward to create the first combat demo, so add Sich Tactics to the Wishlist and follow the news!

If you want to support us, consider purchasing our previous game - Field Hospital: Dr. Taylor’s Story, which has a 50% discount during the Festival.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1315120/Field_Hospital_Dr_Taylors_Story/

Also we encourage you to visit Ukrainian Games Festival page and check out other great games from talanted ukrainian developers. 

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/ukrainiangames2023][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42597953/f949d613d7c819ffa45487547ef1785d54af5b85.png[/img][/url]

Enjoy the Festival!

notes.title: Development Update #2
notes.notes:
Greetings! 

We want to share some details about the game development. We have some exciting news to share. 

Firstly, two new people have joined our team: a writer who is working on the game's storyline and overall narrative, and another programmer. As a result, game development is now in full swing, and soon we'll be able to show you more. We are currently working on creating a game demo. As for the release timeline, we can't provide a clear date just yet. However, the processes are now progressing faster than before. While you wait for more news, let me tell you something else. 

Recently, we switched to Spine for creating better and more enjoyable animations to enhance the gaming experience. We have updated a significant number of animations, and although they may not look perfect yet, we believe they are much better. We are also working on diversifying the game characters and their visual appearance, which will depend on their level or location. We are continuing our work, and we appreciate your support. 

[b]Please add the game to your wishlist and share your feedback.

By the way, if you want to support us, our previous game "Field Hospital: Dr. Taylor's Story" is currently on sale with a 71% discount.[/b]

notes.title: Development Update
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

After a prolonged silence, we want to share some good news.

We are once again entering the active phase of development of our next game - Sich Tactics. We are working on interesting mechanics to diversify the gameplay.

Let's lift the veil a little. Since the Cossacks were famous for their cunning and ingenuity, we want to convey this through game mechanics. For example, we are developing a system of interaction between characters controlled by the player, which will add more in-depth tactical decisions. We will try to achieve such a result that the interaction of combat units among themselves brings more benefit. But let’s not spoil the dessert and leave it for later.

Also, intensive work is currently underway with graphics, namely the creation of new characters, development of animations, user interface, and so on.

There will be more news about the project soon, so add it to the wishlist and follow the development of the game!

And while you wait for the news, we present to you the main theme music of Sich Tactics.
